items.a: This depends on the type of service. With SMM, the first results — follower growth, engagement and inquiries — begin to appear within 4–6 weeks. With SEO, the first ranking improvements are seen within 2–3 months, while significant results are achieved in 4–6 months. We provide detailed monthly reports so you can track progress together with us.

SEO (Search Engine Optimisation) ensures your website appears at the top of search engines like Google. The vast majority of people only look at the first page of search results. Without SEO, potential customers simply cannot find you. With the right SEO strategy, you can attract free, targeted traffic to your site, increase brand credibility and gain a long-term competitive advantage.

items.q: Why is social media marketing (SMM) important?
items.a: Millions of people in Azerbaijan spend time on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok every day. Through SMM, you can introduce your brand to this audience, build direct relationships with customers and increase your sales. Professional SMM management — with the right content strategy, timely posts, targeted ads and active communication — strengthens your brand's online reputation.

items.q: What is the minimum budget for your services?
items.a: The budget varies depending on the type, scope and duration of the service. Every business has different needs — which is why we apply an individual approach. You can estimate the price using our calculator or contact us to learn about the package that suits you best.

items.q: Do you provide support after the project is completed?
items.a: Yes, we are here for you even after the project is completed. We offer various support packages for technical assistance, content updates and website management. Long-term partnership is our priority.

items.q: What payment terms do you apply?
items.a: Typically, 50% advance at the start of the project and the remaining 50% upon completion. An instalment payment plan can also be applied for larger projects. Bank transfer, cash and online payment systems are accepted.

items.question: How long until I see results?
items.answer: Ad campaigns typically provide initial data in the first 1–2 weeks, with Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads campaigns reaching optimal performance (CTR, ROAS) in 4–6 weeks.

items.question: What does the monthly fee cover?
items.answer: Monthly management fee covers strategy, campaign setup, tracking tools setup (Pixel, Conversion API, Yandex Metrica), optimization, and reporting. Ad budget (amount paid to platforms) is separate.

items.question: What reporting mechanism do you use?
items.answer: We provide detailed monthly reports including performance indicators by platform (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Yandex Ads) — spend, CTR, CPC, conversion, ROAS.

items.question: Which platforms do you advertise on?
items.answer: We set up and manage campaigns on Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Yandex Ads, and other platforms.

items.question: What if I have an existing ad account?
items.answer: Nothing needed. We audit your existing Google Ads, Meta Ads, or other accounts to assess their condition, then prepare an optimization plan. Creating a new account is not required.

items.question: How soon will I see results?
items.answer: SMM is a long-term investment. Initial engagement and reach increase is typically felt in 4-6 weeks, while consistent follower growth and conversion to sales manifests over 3-6 months.

items.question: Is advertising budget included in the service fee?
items.answer: No, the service fee covers strategy, content production and management. Advertising budget (Meta/TikTok Ads spend) is determined separately and managed directly from your platform account.

items.question: Which platforms do you operate on?
items.answer: We primarily work on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok, with LinkedIn added based on your needs. Platform selection is based on where your target audience is active.

items.question: Who shoots and prepares the content?
items.answer: Photo/video shooting, design and copywriting are carried out by our team. You only participate in the approval stage, the production process is entirely on us.

items.question: How do you handle negative comments and crisis moments?
items.answer: Comments and messages are monitored according to established response protocol and reacted to promptly. In serious situations, a communication plan pre-agreed with you is implemented.

values.subtitle: OUR VALUES
values.title: The principles that have kept
values.description: Six core values that show up in every project and every client relationship.

items.title: Transparency
items.description: We maintain open, honest communication with our clients at every stage. No hidden costs, no ambiguity.

items.title: Quality
items.description: From the smallest detail to the overarching strategy, we uphold the highest standards in every project we deliver.

items.title: Innovation
items.description: We integrate AI and cutting-edge technology into our work to give our clients a measurable competitive edge.

items.title: Client Focus
items.description: Our clients' success is our success. Every decision we make is guided by their business goals.

items.title: Team Spirit
items.description: Our certified and passionate team of specialists approaches every project together, combining expertise to deliver outstanding outcomes.

items.title: Ethics
items.description: We conduct all marketing activities within the bounds of legal compliance, data privacy, and ethical business principles.

events.title: The Founding of Cradex Agency
events.description: Cradex Agency was established in Baku with the purpose of filling a gap in the digital marketing landscape. We built trust-based partnerships with our first clients and secured our place in the market.

events.title: Expanding Our Service Portfolio
events.description: We added Branding, Graphic Design, and Copywriting to our SEO, SMM, and Web Design offering — evolving into a full 360° marketing agency. We closed more than 50 successful projects.

events.title: The First 100 Projects
events.description: We successfully completed our first 100 projects, broadened our client base, and began operating in 5+ sectors. We strengthened the team and reached new heights.

events.title: Corporate Clients & Certifications
events.description: We began collaborating with large corporate clients. Earning Google and Meta certifications officially confirmed our professional standards. Our project count surpassed 200.

events.title: Geographic Expansion
events.description: We extended our reach across 10+ industries, surpassed the 300-project milestone, and earned the trust of more than 100 clients.

events.title: 350+ Projects & a Look Ahead
events.description: With over 350 successful projects, Cradex Agency became one of Azerbaijan's recognised digital marketing agencies. AI integration and new technologies continue to raise the bar for our service quality.

events.title: A New Chapter: Full Digital Ecosystem
events.description: In 2026, our service portfolio is evolving into a complete digital ecosystem. With video production, AI-powered analytics, and expanded regional partnerships, we are on our way to becoming Azerbaijan's most powerful 360° marketing agency.

services.subtitle: OUR SERVICES
services.title: Everything your brand needs
services.description: Since 2020, we have been bringing every digital need of your brand under one roof with a 360° approach.

items.title: SEO Optimisation
items.description: Rank higher on Google. We grow your organic traffic consistently through technical SEO, keyword strategy, and content optimisation.

items.title: Social Media Marketing
items.description: We amplify your brand's voice through active and engaging social media management across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and LinkedIn.

items.title: Website Development
items.description: Fast, modern, and SEO-ready websites, e-commerce platforms, and landing pages — tailored to your business needs.

items.title: Graphic & Motion Design
items.description: Logo, brand identity, banners, animations, and all visual assets — we build your brand's visual language.

items.title: Video Editing
items.description: Professional editing for ad videos, YouTube content, Reels, and corporate productions.

items.title: Copywriting
items.description: Sales-driven copy, SEO content, blog articles, and social media posts — every word written with purpose.

items.title: Ad Campaigns
items.description: Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads — targeted campaigns that reach the right audience at the right time and maximise ROI.

items.title: Branding
items.description: Brand strategy, visual identity, and style guide — everything you need to build a strong, memorable brand.

items.title: Photo Shoot
items.description: Commercial photography, product photography, and corporate portrait sessions.

cta.title: Become part
cta.description: Tell us your goals — let's write the next success story together.
